item.title: Shallowater head basketball coach hospitalized after crash
item.description: According to a press release from Shallowater ISD, head boy's basketball coach Jay Lusk and his family were involved in a vehicle accident during their trip back from San Antonio on Friday.

item.title: First 6 U.S. military casualties in Iran come back, as Trump promises more airstrikes
item.description: The president promised to avenge their deaths, and more airstrikes hit Iran's capital city on Saturday. Trump warned that more U.S. casualties are likely.

item.title: State of Texas: Trump endorsement could decide Senate runoff between Cornyn and Paxton
item.description: The race for U.S. Senate in Texas is still evolving after primary night, with a looming endorsement from former President Donald Trump expected to shape the Republican runoff.

item.title: Potter County judge candidates outline priorities ahead of general election
item.description: The race for Potter County Judge is now set for the November general election after this week's primary, with Democratic nominee Jerri Glover and Republican nominee Michelle Eggleston both outlining priorities they say are important to voters across the county.

item.title: Make-A-Wish Car Show returns for 41st annual celebration
item.description: The 41st annual car show supporting Make-A-Wish Texas Panhandle is underway this weekend at the Amarillo Civic Center Complex, bringing the community together to celebrate classic cars while helping grant wishes for local children.

item.title: Election results on the High Plains: March 3, 2026 primary elections
item.description: Communities around the Texas Panhandle and High Plains are set to make their voices heard on March 3 by voting on federal, statewide and local candidate primaries, as well as other ballot questions.
